ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into the child care fraud scheme in Minnesota, including the individuals and organizations involved
questions: How much money was funneled to terror groups?
Who was involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and to identify those responsible. It requires a thorough investigation and analysis of financial records and other evidence.
